channel.title: Khalil Charfi - Portfolio Updates
channel.description: Latest projects, publications, and updates from Khalil Charfi.

item.title: Portfolio Website Launched
item.description: Launched a new multilingual portfolio website showcasing my engineering approach, projects, and professional experience.

item.title: CHECK24 Bicycle Insurance Portal
item.description: Context: Collaborative project within Germany's leading comparison portal. Challenge: Legacy PHP templates made the checkout flow slow and harder to maintain. Contribution: Migrated parts of the frontend to Vue.js components and integrated core REST APIs. Outcome: Helped streamline the checkout user flows and improved frontend rendering times.

item.title: Cover 3D Mobile (ASM)
item.description: Context: B2B interior design and order-management application. Challenge: Sales agents in remote areas with unstable internet needed to work reliably without losing orders. Contribution: Implemented CouchDB/PouchDB synchronization for offline storage and replication. Outcome: Enabled reliable offline functionality, helping agents submit orders consistently.

item.title: 3andi & 3andi Partner (ASM)
item.description: Context: Multi-tenant loyalty and digital reward applications for merchants. Challenge: Transitioning physical rewards to digital systems smoothly for both merchants and users. Contribution: Developed Flutter client applications and integrated Firebase for real-time status updates. Outcome: Provided a reliable platform for local vendors to manage digital loyalty programs.

item.title: Business Mobility Suite (ASM)
item.description: Context: Inventory and sales automation tools for retail networks. Challenge: Aligning stock data between sales representatives and central warehouse systems in real time. Contribution: Built Flutter and Ionic apps connected to Laravel-based REST API backends. Outcome: Helped improve data consistency and reduced synchronization issues for warehouse teams.

item.title: Public Transportation App (MyBus)
item.description: Context: Public transit navigation and scheduling application. Challenge: Providing live schedules using noisy GPS data streams without overwhelming mobile connections. Contribution: Designed a GraphQL caching pipeline and integrated Mapbox GL JS for map rendering. Outcome: Delivered transit maps and timetables to commuters with reliable timing estimates.
